triggerCases.prompt: Turn these review findings into concise, copy-pasteable GitHub comments.
Prepare a review document from these confirmed findings without posting it.
Review this pull request for correctness and accessibility.
Address the accepted pull-request feedback and verify the fixes.

outputCases.prompt: Draft the confirmed review comments. Do not modify files or create artifacts; return them in chat only.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: Concise, copy-pasteable comments returned in chat without creating a local artifact or posting to GitHub.
assertions: The response returns the requested comments directly in chat.
The workflow does not create or open a local file because the request prohibits files and artifacts.
The workflow does not post comments or otherwise modify GitHub state.
The inline finding uses the supplied exact file path and line range, while the general finding does not invent a code location.
